definition_ar: أن تتسبب في بدء أو نمو شعور غير سار أو مشكلة ما.
examples_ar: ساعد خطاب السياسي في إثارة غضب الجمهور. | لا تثر ذكريات قديمة من الأفضل نسيانها.

definition_en: to visit in order to enjoy (S); to decrease the size of clothes (S); to deceive, to fool (S)
examples_en: We decided to take in Toronto on our trip to Canada, and that is where we took in the most memorable outdoor stage play we have ever seen. | Lois lost so much weight that she had her skirts and slacks taken in by her tailor. | The fraudulent investment advisor took everyone in with his sincere manner and generous promises. | Most investors lost all their money.
definition_ar: أن تفهم أو تستوعب المعلومات، أو أن تخدع شخصاً ما.
examples_ar: كنت متعباً جداً لدرجة أنني لم أستطع استيعاب ما كان يقوله. | تمكن المحتال من خداع العديد من كبار السن.

definition_en: to undergo, to experience; to consume, to use (also: to use up)
note_en: The first definition is used when someone is having some hardship or difficulty.
examples_en: I can't believe what she went through to get that job. | She had four interviews with the hiring committee in one week! | Frank said that they had gone through all the toilet paper in the house, but Steve couldn't believe that they had used it all up.
definition_ar: أن تمر بموقف صعب أو أن تفحص شيئاً ما بعناية.
examples_ar: إنها تمر بوقت عصيب جداً في الوقت الحالي. | أحتاج إلى مراجعة ملفاتي للعثور على العقد.

definition_en: to be known without the need to mention
note_en: This idiom occurs with a that-clause, often with the pronoun it as the subject.
examples_en: It goes without saying that you shouldn't drive quickly in bad weather. | That he will gain weight if he continues to eat and drink so much goes without saying.
definition_ar: أن يكون الأمر بديهياً لدرجة أنه لا يحتاج إلى ذكره.
examples_ar: من البديهي أن تصل في الوقت المحدد. | غني عن القول أن السلامة هي أولويتنا القصوى.

definition_en: to mislead by joking or tricking (S)
note_en: This idiom is usually used in a continuous tense form. A noun object must divide the idiom.
examples_en: Don't worry. | I wouldn't expect you do all that work by yourself. | I'm just putting you on. | Jack can't be serious about what he said. | He must be putting us on.
definition_ar: أن تحاول جعل شخص ما يصدق شيئاً غير حقيقي، عادة على سبيل المزاح.
examples_ar: هل أنت جاد، أم أنك تمزح معي فقط؟ | ظننت أنه يمزح معي حتى رأيت الخطاب الرسمي.

definition_en: to remain calm during an emergency
examples_en: When the heater caused a fire, Gloria kept her head and phoned for assistance right away; otherwise, the whole house might have burned down. | When the boat starting sinking in heavy seas, the crew members kept their heads and led the passengers to the lifeboats.
definition_ar: أن تظل هادئاً في موقف صعب أو خطير.
examples_ar: حتى أثناء الحريق، تمكنت من الحفاظ على هدوئها وإخراج الجميع. | من المهم أن تحافظ على هدوئك عندما تسوء الأمور.

definition_en: not to think clearly, to lose one's self-control
examples_en: When Mel saw a dog in the street right in front of his car, he lost his head and drove onto the sidewalk and into a tree. | If the politician hadn't gotten stirred up and lost his head, he never would have criticized his opponent unfairly.
definition_ar: أن تفقد السيطرة على مشاعرك وتتصرف بطريقة مشوشة أو غاضبة.
examples_ar: فقد أعصابه وبدأ بالصراخ على الجميع. | لا تفقد صوابك لمجرد خطأ بسيط.

definition_en: not willing to accept the ideas of others (the opposite of narrow minded is broad-minded)
examples_en: Narrow-minded people tend to discriminate against groups of people with which they have nothing in common. | Ted is so broad-minded that he has almost no standards by which he judges others.
definition_ar: غير مستعد لتقبل أو فهم أفكار جديدة أو مختلفة.
examples_ar: إنه ضيق الأفق لدرجة أنه لا يقدر الثقافات المختلفة. | من المحبط التعامل مع هؤلاء الأشخاص ضيقي الأفق.

definition_en: to withstand use or wear; to fail to appear for a date or social engagement (S)
examples_en: My old car has stood up well over the years. | I haven't had any major problems at all. | Janet was very angry because her new boyfriend stood her up on their second date. | She waited over an hour for him before returning home.
definition_ar: النهوض إلى وضع عمودي من وضعية الجلوس أو الاستلقاء.
examples_ar: يرجى الوقوف عندما يدخل المعلم الغرفة. | نهض لاستقبال ضيوفه.

definition_en: to win or defeat by gaining an advantage over someone
examples_en: Jim doesn't seem very athletic at tennis, but if you're not careful, he'll get the better of you. | Lynn gets frustrated when Bruce gets the better of her in arguments. | No matter what she says, he always has a clever response.
definition_ar: أن تهزم شخصاً ما أو أن تكون أقوى من شخص في منافسة أو موقف.
examples_ar: تغلب فضوله عليه، ففتح الصندوق. | لا تدع غضبك يتغلب عليك.

definition_en: to become free or loose, to escape
examples_en: During the bad storm, the boat broke loose from the landing and drifted out to sea. | One bicyclist broke loose from the pack of racers and pulled ahead towards the finish line.
definition_ar: أن تهرب من كونك مقيداً أو مربوطاً.
examples_ar: تمكن الكلب من الإفلات من مقوده. | تحرر الحصان وركض نحو الحقل.

definition_en: nervous, anxious; upset, irritable
examples_en: Cynthia was on edge all day about the important presentation she had to give to the local citizens group. | I don't like being around Jake when he's on edge like that. | Someone should tell him to calm down and relax.
definition_ar: الشعور بالتوتر أو القلق أو سرعة الانفعال.
examples_ar: كانت على أعصابها طوال اليوم بانتظار نتائج الاختبار. | الأصوات العالية في الشارع جعلتني في حالة توتر.

definition_en: not be able to convince someone
note_en: This idiom is used when someone is wasting time trying to convince another person. The idiom to save one's breath is related and means not to waste effort trying to convince someone.
examples_en: Don't argue with Frank any longer. | You are wasting your breath trying to get him to agree with you. | I have already decided what I'm going to do. | You can't change my mind, so save your breath.
arabic: يضيع وقته في الكلام، ينفخ في قربة مقطوعة، يتكلم بلا فائدة
definition_ar: التحدث إلى شخص لن يستمع أو الكلام دون تحقيق أي نتيجة.
examples_ar: لا تحاول إقناعه؛ أنت تضيع وقتك في الكلام بلا فائدة. | كنت أعلم أنني أضيع وقتي في الكلام عند محاولة شرح القواعد له.

definition_en: to make shorter, to interrupt (S)
examples_en: The moderator asked the speaker to cut short his talk because there wasn't much time remaining for questions from the audience. | We were very unfortunate when we received bad news from home that forced us to cut our trip short.
definition_ar: إيقاف شيء ما قبل اكتماله أو قبل الوقت المخطط له.
examples_ar: اضطررنا لقطع إجازتنا مبكراً بسبب العاصفة. | اضطر الممثل لإنهاء أدائه مبكراً بسبب المرض.

definition_en: to become involved or concerned with something; to enter a place for a brief time (also: to step into)
examples_en: When the children started fighting on the play-ground, a teacher had to step in and stop the fight. | The supervisor asked one of the employees to step in her office for a moment. | Would you step into the hallway so that I can show you the information posted on the bulletin board?
definition_ar: التدخل في موقف صعب للمساعدة أو لأخذ مكان شخص آخر.
examples_ar: اضطر المدير للتدخل لحل النزاع بين الموظفين. | عندما مرض المغني الرئيسي، حل محله البديل.

definition_en: to retire or leave a top position, to resign
examples_en: Next May the principal will step down after thirty-five years of service to the school. | The angry shareholders wanted the company president to step down because of the stock scandal.
definition_ar: الاستقالة أو ترك وظيفة أو منصب مهم.
examples_ar: قرر المدير التنفيذي التنحي عن منصبه بعد عشر سنوات من الخدمة. | أُجبر الوزير على التنحي بسبب الفضيحة.

definition_en: to treat severely, to discipline; to go faster, to work more quickly
note_en: For the second definition, the idiom is followed by the pronoun it.
examples_en: Sometimes it's necessary to step on children when they do something dangerous. | We're going to be late for the movies. | You'd better step on it!
definition_ar: وضع قدمك على شيء ما أو شخص ما.
examples_ar: احذر من أن تدوس على الزهور في الحديقة. | دست على قدمه بالخطأ في الغرفة المزدحمة.

definition_en: very inexpensive, a bargain
note_en: This idiom is often used in an exclamation using what.
examples_en: I can't believe that I paid only $2,000 for this three-year-old car. | What a steal! | Scott considered it a steal when he bought a complete bedroom set for only $99.
definition_ar: شيء رخيص جداً أو صفقة ممتازة.
examples_ar: كانت هذه السترة بعشرة دولارات فقط؛ لقد كانت صفقة رابحة! | شراء ذلك المنزل بهذا السعر كان صفقة رابحة.

definition_en: to behave so as to gain favor with someone
examples_en: The other students in the class resent Jim because he plays up to the teacher in order to get better grades. | When my children asked me to go shopping for a new video game, I knew why they had been playing up to me all morning.
definition_ar: التصرف بطريقة تهدف إلى إرضاء شخص ما، غالباً للحصول على ميزة.
examples_ar: إنه يتملق المدير دائماً للحصول على ترقية. | تملقت الحكام لتفوز بالمسابقة.

definition_en: approximately, almost; somewhat, to a certain degree
examples_en: Although your bedroom feels smaller, it's more or less the same size as mine. | Ted more or less agreed with our decision to put off the meeting until more members could show up. | At least he didn't object strongly.
definition_ar: تقريباً أو إلى حد معين.
examples_ar: العمل انتهى تقريباً. | لقد قررت تقريباً ما يجب فعله.

definition_en: to confuse, to scramble (S); to cause problems in (S)
examples_en: Chris had trouble finding Jane's apartment because the addresses of the buildings screwed him up. | Instead of fixing the television set, the technician screwed it up even more.
definition_ar: ارتكاب خطأ أو إفساد شيء ما.
examples_ar: لقد أفسدت العرض التقديمي حقاً بنسيان ملاحظاتي. | لقد أفسد فرصه في الحصول على الوظيفة.

definition_en: to perform badly, to make a mistake (also: to mess up, to slip up)
examples_en: I really goofed up on the exam today; did you mess up, too? | Karen slipped up when she forgot to deposit money into her checking account.
definition_ar: ارتكاب خطأ سخيف أو غير مقصود.
examples_ar: أفسدت الوصفة بإضافة الملح بدلاً من السكر. | أفسد التقرير باستخدام بيانات خاطئة.

text: to go off the deep end
definition_en: to get very angry and do something hastily
examples_en: Just because you had a serious argument with your supervisor, you didn't have to go off the deep end and resign, did you? | When Dan's wife demanded a divorce, he went off the deep end again. | This time he was shouting so that the whole neighborhood could hear.
arabic: يفقد أعصابه، يجن جنونه، يتصرف بتهور
definition_ar: فقدان السيطرة على العواطف أو التصرف بطريقة متطرفة أو غير عقلانية.
examples_ar: فقد أعصابه تماماً عندما سمع الأخبار. | فقدت صوابها واستقالت من وظيفتها دون خطة.

definition_en: to fail at what one used to do well
examples_en: Milton used to be the best salesman at the car dealership, but recently he seems to have lost his touch. | I used to play tennis very well, but today you beat me easily. | I must be losing my touch.
definition_ar: فقدان القدرة أو المهارة التي كان يمتلكها الشخص سابقاً.
examples_ar: كان رساماً رائعاً، لكن يبدو أنه فقد مهارته. | أثبت المدرب المخضرم أنه لم يفقد مهارته بفوزه بالبطولة.

definition_en: under firm control, well managed
examples_en: The copilot asked the pilot if he had the plane in hand or whether he needed any help navigating through the severe thunderstorm. | The police officer radioed to the station that she had the emergency situation in hand and didn't require any assistance.
definition_ar: أن يكون الأمر قيد المعالجة أو تحت السيطرة.
examples_ar: الوضع تحت السيطرة تماماً. | لا تقلق، الشرطة تسيطر على التحقيق.

definition_en: available, nearby
note_en: This idiom is often followed by in case.
examples_en: I always keep some extra money on hand in case I forget to get cash from the bank. | The concert organizers arranged to have some security guards on hand in case there were any problems during the performance.
arabic: متوفر، موجود تحت اليد، جاهز للاستخدام
definition_ar: متاح للاستخدام أو موجود حالياً.
examples_ar: لدينا الكثير من الإمدادات المتوفرة. | هل لديك أي نقود متوفرة؟

definition_en: to discuss informally (over a period of time) (S) (also: to toss around)
examples_en: At first my friends were reluctant to consider my suggestion, but they finally were willing to kick it around for a while. | Herb thought that we should kick around the idea of establishing a special fund for supporting needy members of the club.
arabic: مناقشة فكرة، التفكير في أمر، تداول موضوع
definition_ar: مناقشة فكرة أو خطة بشكل غير رسمي.
examples_ar: دعونا نتداول بعض الأفكار من أجل الحفلة. | قضينا فترة بعد الظهر في مناقشة استراتيجيات تسويقية مختلفة.

definition_en: be attentive, competent, alert
examples_en: Jim was the only one who caught that serious error in the bookkeeping statements. | He's really on the ball. | Ella was certainly on the ball when she remembered to reconfirm our flight arrangements. | All the rest of us would have forgotten.
definition_ar: أن تكون يقظاً، سريع الفهم، ومستعداً للتصرف.
examples_ar: يجب أن تكون يقظاً إذا أردت النجاح في هذه الوظيفة. | المساعدة الجديدة يقظة جداً؛ فقد أنهت التقرير في ساعة واحدة.

definition_en: to meet or fulfill a missed obligation at a later time (S); to create, to invent (an idea) (S); to apply cosmetics to (S); to comprise, to be composed of
note_en: Note that all of the definitions are separable except the last one.
examples_en: The teacher allowed several students who missed the exam to make it up during the next class. | The little boy made up a bad excuse for wearing his dirty shoes in the house, so his mother punished him. | Dee was able to make her face up in half the normal time because she didn't use much makeup. | Two separate bodies — the House of Representatives and the Senate — make up the Congress of the United States.
definition_ar: اختلاق شيء كاذب، أو التصالح بعد خلاف.
examples_ar: تشاجرا، لكنهما تصالحا بسرعة. | اختلق عذراً لتأخره.

definition_en: to resolve differences with
note_en: This idiom is used for differences of opinion between friends and lovers.
examples_en: Gundula made up with her roommate after their serious misunderstanding about arrangements for the party. | After the bad quarrel the two lovers kissed and made up with each other.
definition_ar: أن تصبح ودوداً مجدداً مع شخص ما بعد خلاف.
examples_ar: آمل أن يتصالحا مع بعضهما قريباً. | بعد أسابيع من الصمت، قررت التصالح مع أخيها.

definition_en: to gather, to collect (information) (S); to gain control of one's emotions (S)
note_en: A reflexive pronoun must be used for the second definition.
examples_en: The reporter pulled together information from several sources in preparing the newspaper article. | Mr. | Simpson was so frightened when he heard footsteps behind him on the lonely, dark street that it took several minutes to pull himself together.
definition_ar: العمل معاً بفعالية كمجموعة أو استعادة الهدوء والسيطرة على النفس.
examples_ar: نحتاج للتعاون معاً لإنهاء هذا المشروع في الوقت المحدد. | تعاون المجتمع لمساعدة ضحايا الفيضان.

definition_en: to appear promising or optimistic, to be improving
note_en: This idiom is used in a continuous tense, very often with the subject things.
examples_en: The board chairman is glad to report that things are looking up for the company after several years of declining sales. | Prospects for building that new library in the downtown area are looking up.
definition_ar: إظهار علامات التحسن.
examples_ar: الأمور تتحسن أخيراً بالنسبة لعملنا. | بعد عام صعب، وضعنا المالي في تحسن.

definition_en: to stop a bad habit
examples_en: Once a child becomes accustomed to chewing his nails, it's difficult to kick the habit. | The doctor advised the heavy cigarette smoker that her heart had become damaged and that she should kick the habit right away.
arabic: الإقلاع عن عادة، التخلص من عادة سيئة
definition_ar: التوقف عن فعل شيء ضار كنت تفعله لفترة طويلة.
examples_ar: من الصعب الإقلاع عن عادة التدخين. | تمكن من الإقلاع عن عادة شرب القهوة في وقت متأخر من الليل.

definition_en: to conceal, to hide (S)
note_en: This idiom is used for events which are potentially embarrassing to one's reputation, as well as against the law. The noun coverup can be formed.
examples_en: The office worker tried to cover up his crimes, but everyone knew that he had been stealing office supplies all along. | The political coverup of the bribery scandal failed and was reported by all the major media.
definition_ar: إخفاء الحقيقة حول شيء ما، عادة ما يكون جريمة أو خطأ.
examples_ar: حاولوا التستر على الفضيحة. | اتُهمت الشركة بمحاولة التستر على مشاكل السلامة.

definition_en: to fall asleep; to take to a certain location (S); to decrease (for the third definition, also: to fall off)
examples_en: My mother dropped off during the boring television show; her head was nodding up and down. | I don't mind dropping you off at the store on my way to work. | Business has been dropping off rapidly recently, but fortunately it hasn't been falling off as quickly as for our competitors.
definition_ar: أن تأخذ شخصاً أو شيئاً إلى مكان ما وتتركه هناك.
examples_ar: سأوصلك إلى المحطة في طريقي إلى العمل. | هل يمكنك توصيل هذه المستندات إلى المكتب؟

definition_en: to place upside down (S); to flip, to turn upside down; to pass or give control to someone (S)
examples_en: The teacher asked the students to turn the answer sheet over and to write a short essay on the back. | The car was going too fast around the corner and turned over twice. | Mr. | Collins has decided to turn over his jewelry store to his son at the end of the year.
definition_ar: أن تقلب شيئاً ما أو تسلم السيطرة أو المسؤولية لشخص آخر.
examples_ar: يرجى قلب الصفحة لقراءة الفصل التالي. | قررت الشركة تسليم الإدارة لفريق جديد.

definition_en: to send a request through the normal way
note_en: This idiom can be used with the adjective proper.
examples_en: If you go through proper channels in this company, it's sometimes impossible to get anything done quickly. | The police told the important civic leader that even she had to go through channels in reporting the burglary of her house.
arabic: يتبع الإجراءات الرسمية، يسلك الطرق الإدارية
definition_ar: اتباع الإجراءات الرسمية أو المعتمدة لإنجاز أمر ما.
examples_ar: إذا كنت تريد تصريحاً، فعليك اتباع الإجراءات الرسمية. | تم رفض الطلب لأنه لم يمر عبر القنوات الرسمية المناسبة.

definition_en: the final event in a series of unacceptable actions
note_en: This idiom is always used with the definite article the.
examples_en: When John asked to borrow money from me for the fourth time, it was the last straw. | I finally told him that I couldn't lend him any more. | I can't believe that my roommate left the door to our apartment unlocked again. | It's the last straw; I'm moving out.
arabic: القشة التي قصمت ظهر البعير، السبب الأخير للصبر
definition_ar: المشكلة الأخيرة في سلسلة من المشاكل التي تجعل الوضع لا يطاق.
examples_ar: كان منزعجاً بالفعل، لكن وقاحتها كانت القشة التي قصمت ظهر البعير. | كان فقدان مفاتيحي هو القشة التي قصمت ظهر البعير بعد يوم فظيع.

definition_en: to become unable or afraid to do something
note_en: This idiom is usually used in the case of an important or dangerous action.
examples_en: Karl was supposed to marry Elaine this weekend, but at the last moment he got cold feet. | Only one of the rock climbers got cold feet when the group reached the base of the hundred-meter cliff.
arabic: يتردد، يخاف في اللحظة الأخيرة، يتراجع عن قراره
definition_ar: أن تصبح متوتراً أو خائفاً جداً من القيام بشيء كنت قد خططت له.
examples_ar: تردد وخاف في اللحظة الأخيرة قبل الزفاف. | لا تتردد الآن؛ لقد قطعنا شوطاً طويلاً.

definition_en: to receive credit for the value of an old item towards the purchase of a new item (S)
note_en: This idiom is used to form the noun trade-in.
examples_en: The car dealership offered me $1,000 for my old car if I traded it in for a new model. | The appliance company was offering a $50 trade-in during the special promotion for its new line of refrigerators.
definition_ar: أن تعطي منتجاً قديماً كجزء من ثمن شراء منتج جديد.
examples_ar: قررت استبدال سيارتي القديمة بطراز أحدث. | يمكنك استبدال هاتفك القديم للحصول على خصم.

definition_en: direct, personal; directly, personally (written without hyphens)
note_en: This idiom can be used both as an adjective (the first definition) and as an adverb (the second definition).
examples_en: The workers' representatives had a face-to-face meeting with the management to resolve the salary issue. | The stepmother and her teenage son talked face to face about his troubles in school.
definition_ar: تتضمن أشخاصاً قريبين من بعضهم وينظرون إلى بعضهم البعض.
examples_ar: نحتاج إلى اجتماع وجهاً لوجه لمناقشة هذا الأمر. | من الأفضل حل النزاعات وجهاً لوجه.

definition_en: to support, to back (also: to go along with); to understand or follow what someone is saying
examples_en: Although others thought that we shouldn't go along with Jerry, I told Jerry that I was with him on his proposal for reorganizing the staff. | After turning left at the traffic light, go two blocks and turn right on Madison. | After three more blocks, turn right again. | Are you still with me?
definition_ar: أن تدعم أو تتفق مع رأي أو تصرفات شخص ما.
examples_ar: أنا معك في هذا القرار؛ إنه القرار الصائب. | معظم الفريق يؤيده في هذا المشروع.

definition_en: to be able to focus or concentrate on (also: to get with it)
note_en: To be with it in the negative has the same meaning as to feel out of it. The related form to get with it is used in commands.
examples_en: Jack's really with it today. | I've never seen him play such good soccer. | You've done only a small amount of work in two hours. | You're not with it today, are you? | It's no excuse to say that you feel out of it. | We need everyone's help on this, so get with it!
arabic: مواكب للعصر، مدرك لما يدور حوله، واعٍ
definition_ar: أن تكون عصرياً أو مواكباً للاتجاهات والأحداث الحالية.
examples_ar: إنها مواكبة للعصر حقاً؛ فهي تعرف كل التقنيات الحديثة. | إنه يتقدم في السن، لكنه لا يزال مواكباً لما يدور حوله.

definition_en: to fall in love quickly; to be fooled or tricked by
examples_en: Samantha and Derek never expected to fall for each other like they did, but they got married within two weeks of having met. | The Masons wanted to believe their son, but unfortunately they had fallen for his lies too many times to be deceived once again.
definition_ar: أن تقع في حب شخص ما أو أن تنخدع بكذبة أو مزحة.
examples_ar: وقع في حبها في اللحظة التي رآها فيها. | انخدعت بقصته حول كونه مليونيراً.

definition_en: it seems likely, reasonable, or typical
note_en: This idiom is either followed by a that-clause or by no other part of grammar.
examples_en: It figures that the children were willing to help with the yardwork only if they received a reward for doing so. | When I told Evan that his secretary was unhappy about not getting a raise, he said that it figured.
definition_ar: تُستخدم للتعبير عن أن شيئاً ما متوقع أو غير مفاجئ، وغالباً ما تُستخدم في سياق سلبي.
examples_ar: تأخر القطار مجدداً؛ حسناً، هذا متوقع. | لقد نسي مفاتيحه مجدداً؛ هذا متوقع.

definition_en: to inform, to give background information to (also: to clue in) (S)
note_en: This idiom is often followed by the preposition on and a noun phrase containing the pertinent information.
examples_en: Could you fill me in on what is going to be discussed at tomorrow's meeting? | Not having been to the convention, my associate asked me to clue him in on the proceedings.
definition_ar: تزويد شخص ما بمعلومات أو تفاصيل ناقصة حول موقف معين.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك إطلاعي على ما حدث في الاجتماع؟ | أطلعته على متطلبات المشروع الجديدة.

definition_en: to motivate to behave or act in a certain way (S)
note_en: This idiom is used within a what-clause.
examples_en: If a salesperson knows what makes a customer tick, he will be able to sell a lot of merchandise. | It's been impossible for us to figure out what makes our new boss tick. | One moment she seems pleasant and then the next moment she's upset.
arabic: يفهم دوافع شخص، يعرف ما يحرك شخصاً
definition_ar: فهم دوافع الشخص أو شخصيته أو ما يحركه من الداخل.
examples_ar: بعد سنوات من العمل معاً، فهمت أخيراً ما يحركه. | من الصعب معرفة ما يحركها.

definition_en: to take someone's place temporarily, to substitute for; to protect someone by lying or deceiving
examples_en: Go ahead and take your coffee break. | I'll cover for you until you return. | The criminal made his wife cover for him when the police asked if the man had been home all day. | She swore that he had been there.
arabic: يغطي على شخص، ينوب عن شخص
definition_ar: القيام بعمل شخص ما بدلاً منه أو تقديم عذر لغيابه أو خطئه.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك التغطية عليّ بينما أذهب لطبيب الأسنان؟ | اضطرت للتغطية على شريكها أثناء الاجتماع.

definition_en: to provide a person with another opportunity or chance (S); not to expect too much work from (S); not to expect someone to believe (S)
note_en: Command forms are most common with this idiom. For the third definition, the pronoun me must be used.
examples_en: The driver pleaded with the police officer to give him a break and not issue him a ticket for speeding. | When the students heard how much homework the teacher wanted them to do over the holiday, they begged, "Give us a break, Professor Doyle!" Oh, Jim, give me a break! | That's a terrible excuse for being late.
definition_ar: التوقف عن انتقاد أو الضغط على شخص ما؛ أن تكون متساهلاً.
examples_ar: امنحه فرصة؛ لقد كان يعمل طوال الليل. | منح المعلم الطلاب استراحة بعد الامتحان.

definition_en: to stop doing as a regular activity, to remove oneself from a situation
note_en: The related idiom to want out indicates that someone desires to bow out.
examples_en: She bowed out as the school's registrar after sixteen years of service. | One of the two partners wanted out of the deal because they couldn't agree on the terms of the contract.
definition_ar: الانسحاب أو الاستقالة من نشاط أو منافسة أو دور معين.
examples_ar: قرر الانسحاب من السباق بسبب مشاكل صحية. | اضطرت للانسحاب من المشروع بسبب جدول أعمالها.

definition_en: to find guilty of a crime or offense (S) (also: to hang on)
note_en: This idiom is divided by a noun phrase containing the crime or offense. The accused person is mentioned after the preposition on.
examples_en: The prosecuting attorney tried to pin the murder on the victim's husband, but the jury returned a verdict of "not guilty." I wasn't anywhere near the window when it got broken. | You can't pin that on me.
arabic: يلصق تهمة بـ، يحمل شخصاً مسؤولية
definition_ar: إلقاء اللوم على شخص ما لشيء ما، وغالباً ما يكون ذلك بغير حق.
examples_ar: لا تحاول إلصاق التهمة بي! | حاولوا إلصاق تهمة السرقة برجل بريء.

text: to get a rise out of
definition_en: to provoke a response from
note_en: This idiom is usually used when someone is teased into responding in anger or annoyance.
examples_en: You can kid me all day about my mistake, but you won't get a rise out of me. | I got a rise out of Marvin when I teased him about his weight. | Marvin weighs over two-hundred pounds.
definition_ar: استفزاز شخص ما لجعله يتفاعل، عادةً بالغضب أو الانزعاج.
examples_ar: يستمر في مضايقتها فقط ليثير غضبها. | لا تدعه يستفزك.

definition_en: to stay or remain where one is, to wait
note_en: This idiom is used when someone is waiting for something to happen or for someone to arrive.
examples_en: Todd had to stick around the house all day until the new furniture was finally delivered in the late afternoon. | Why don't you stick around for a while and see if Sarah eventually shows up?
definition_ar: البقاء في مكان ما لفترة من الزمن، غالباً بانتظار حدوث شيء ما.
examples_ar: إذا بقيت هنا، قد تشاهد العرض. | سأبقى هنا حتى ينتهي الاجتماع.

definition_en: to pay the cost or bill
note_en: This idiom applies when someone pays for the cost of another person's meal, tickets, etc.
examples_en: The advertising manager is flying to Puerto Rico for a conference, and her firm is picking up the tab. | The government picked up the tab for the visiting dignitary. | It paid for all of the lodging and meals, as well as transportation, during his stay.
definition_ar: دفع ثمن شيء ما، خاصة فاتورة في مطعم أو لمجموعة.
examples_ar: لا تقلق، سأدفع الحساب هذه المرة. | ستتكفل الشركة بمصاريف سفرنا.

definition_en: incidentally
note_en: This idiom is used when someone thinks of something further in the course of a conversation.
examples_en: Movies are my favorite form of entertainment. | Oh, by the way, have you seen the new picture that's playing at the Bijou? | Vera's been divorced for three years now. | She told me, by the way, that she never plans to remarry.
definition_ar: تُستخدم لتقديم موضوع جديد أو معلومة إضافية.
examples_ar: بالمناسبة، هل رأيت الأخبار؟ | بالمناسبة، نسيت أن أذكر الاجتماع.

definition_en: to do something with enthusiasm and thoroughness
examples_en: Our interior decorator really went to town in remodeling our living room. | I'm afraid to ask how much it's going to cost. | Charlie really went to town on his research project. | He consulted over forty reference works and wrote a ninety-page report.
arabic: يبذل قصارى جهده، يعمل بحماس، يفرط في الشيء
definition_ar: أن تقوم بعمل شيء ما بحماس كبير أو طاقة عالية أو بإتقان شديد.
examples_ar: لقد بذلت جهداً كبيراً في تزيين الحفل. | أبدع الطاهي في قائمة الطعام الجديدة، مضيفاً عشرات المكونات الغريبة.

definition_en: to neglect a duty (S); to ignore a situation (S)
examples_en: Terry knew that she should have paid the electric bill on time instead of letting it slide. | Now the utility company has turned off her service. | When he tried to get a rise out of me by mentioning my failure to receive a promotion at work, I just let it slide.
arabic: يتغاضى عن، يهمل، يترك الأمور تسير دون تدخل
definition_ar: تجاهل شيء ما أو إهماله، أو السماح للوضع بالتدهور دون اتخاذ إجراء.
examples_ar: قررت أن أتغاضى عن تعليقه الوقح هذه المرة. | إذا أهملت دراستك، ستندم على ذلك أثناء الامتحانات.

definition_en: I don't know (also: beats me)
note_en: This idiom is used informally, usually as a command form.
examples_en: When Elmer asked his wife if she knew why the new neighbors left their garage door open all night, she responded, "Search me." When I asked Dereck why his girlfriend wasn't at the party yet, he said, "Beats me. | I expected her an hour ago."
arabic: لا أعرف، ليس لدي أدنى فكرة
definition_ar: طريقة غير رسمية للقول بأنك لا تعرف إجابة السؤال.
examples_ar: إلى أين ذهب؟ لا أعلم! | لماذا المتجر مغلق اليوم؟ لا أعلم.

definition_en: to express one's true feelings (S)
note_en: This idiom is used when someone has long waited to express themselves.
examples_en: Ellen felt a lot better when she finally talked to a counselor and got the problem off her chest. | Faye hasn't shared her concern about her marriage with her husband yet. | I think that she should get it off her chest soon.
arabic: يفضفض، يخرج ما في قلبه، يصارح
definition_ar: التعبير عن شيء كان يقلقك أو يزعجك لفترة طويلة.
examples_ar: كان عليّ أن أخرج ما في قلبي قبل أن أتمكن من النوم. | التحدث إلى صديق ساعدني في إخراج الكثير من الهموم التي كانت في قلبي.

definition_en: to spend money freely, to live luxuriously
examples_en: Kyle and Eric saved up money for two years so that they could travel to Europe and live it up. | After receiving a large inheritance from a rich aunt, I was able to live it up for years.
arabic: يستمتع بحياته، يعيش حياة صاخبة، يسرف في اللهو
definition_ar: الاستمتاع بالوقت بطريقة مثيرة وغالباً ما تكون مكلفة.
examples_ar: ذهبوا إلى باريس ليستمتعوا بحياتهم لمدة أسبوع. | بعد الفوز باليانصيب، قرر أن يستمتع بحياته لفترة.

definition_en: to energize, to make more active (also: to pick up) (S)
examples_en: The teacher occasionally took the class on field trips just to liven things up a bit. | The animals in the zoo began to liven up when evening came and the temperatures dropped. | Many people have to drink coffee every morning just to pick themselves up.
arabic: ينعش، يضفي حيوية، يجعل المكان أكثر بهجة
definition_ar: جعل شيء ما أو شخص ما أكثر إثارة أو حيوية أو بهجة.
examples_ar: بعض الموسيقى ستضفي حقاً حيوية على هذا الحفل. | إضافة وسائد ملونة يمكن أن تضفي حيوية على غرفة معيشة باهتة.

definition_en: to share involvement in
examples_en: The new vice-president was promised that she would have a voice in developing the company's international expansion. | The students are trying to have a voice in college affairs by gaining representation on administrative committees.
arabic: يكون له رأي في، يشارك في اتخاذ القرار
definition_ar: امتلاك الحق أو الفرصة للتأثير في قرار أو المشاركة في عملية ما.
examples_ar: يجب أن يكون للموظفين رأي في كيفية إدارة الشركة. | أصرت على أن يكون لها رأي في اختيار أعضاء الفريق الجدد.

definition_en: to register at a hotel or motel; to leave or deposit for transporting or safekeeping (S)
note_en: The adjective form check-in derives from this idiom.
examples_en: Courtney arrived in town at mid-day and promptly checked in at the Plaza Hotel. | The hotel permitted an early check-in time. | There were dozens of people at the airline counters waiting to check their bags in for their flights.
arabic: يسجل الوصول، يبلغ عن وصوله، يراجع
definition_ar: الإبلاغ عن وصولك إلى فندق أو مطار، أو الاتصال بشخص ما لتقديم تحديث.
examples_ar: نحتاج إلى تسجيل الوصول في الفندق قبل أن نذهب للتجول. | سأتواصل معك لاحقاً لأرى كيف حالك.

definition_en: to pay the bill at a hotel or motel and then leave; to investigate, to examine (S)
note_en: The adjective form check-out derives from this idiom.
examples_en: The latest you should check out of the hotel is 12 noon. | However, in your case, we can set a special check-out time of 2:00 P.M. | The police received a call from someone claiming to have witnessed a murder. | The police sent two detectives to check the call out right away.
definition_ar: مغادرة فندق بعد الدفع، أو فحص شيء ما للتأكد من صحته أو اهتمامك به.
examples_ar: علينا مغادرة غرفتنا بحلول الظهر. | يجب أن تجرب ذلك المطعم الجديد في وسط المدينة؛ الطعام مذهل.

text: to take somebody at one's word
definition_en: to accept what one says as true, to believe
examples_en: When he offered to be responsible for the fund raiser, I took him at his word. | Now he's saying that he's not available to do it. | You should be careful about taking her at her word. | She's been known to say one thing but to do another.
arabic: يصدق كلام شخص، يثق في وعود شخص
definition_ar: تصديق أن ما يقوله شخص ما هو الحقيقة وأنه سيحدث كما وعد.
examples_ar: قال إنه سيساعد، لذا صدقت كلامه. | صدقت كلامه عندما وعد بإنهاء التقرير بحلول يوم الجمعة.

definition_en: to be useful, to suit one's needs or requirements
examples_en: I don't have a screwdriver to open this, but I think that a knife will serve the purpose. | Jane prefers working to studying, so it served her purpose to drop out of school and take that job.
arabic: يؤدي الغرض، يفي بالمطلوب، يحقق الهدف
definition_ar: أن يكون كافياً أو مناسباً لاحتياج أو هدف معين.
examples_ar: هذه السيارة القديمة لا تزال تؤدي الغرض للرحلات القصيرة. | أدت الطاولة المؤقتة الغرض منها أثناء الحفلة.

definition_en: very much, greatly
examples_en: Jim and Claudia want to have children in the worst way. | They are trying very hard to conceive. | Because Umer has relatives in Turkey, he wants to visit there in the worst way.
arabic: بشدة، بكل ما أوتيت من قوة، بإلحاح
definition_ar: بدرجة كبيرة جداً أو برغبة شديدة.
examples_ar: أريد الذهاب إلى الحفل الموسيقي بشدة. | إنه يحتاج إلى إجازة بشدة.

definition_en: to avoid one's responsibility, to quit
note_en: This idiom is an informal version of the second definition to back out (lesson 29). The noun form copout means an excuse for avoiding responsibility.
examples_en: Evelyn had agreed to help us with arrangements for the party, but she copped out at the last minute. | I can't believe that Cindy offered such an explanation for failing to show up. | What a poor copout!
definition_ar: تجنب القيام بشيء وعدت به أو كان ينبغي عليك القيام به.
examples_ar: لا تتملص الآن لمجرد أن العمل صعب. | تملص من الاتفاق في اللحظة الأخيرة.

definition_en: to form a line; to arrange to have, to manage to obtain (S)
examples_en: The moviegoers lined up in front of the theater showing the most popular film of the summer. | Rob is going to schedule the famous author to speak at the convention if he can line her up in time.
definition_ar: تشكيل صف أو ترتيب الأشياء في نظام معين.
examples_ar: اصطف الطلاب لدخول الفصل. | لقد رتبت لاجتماع صباح الغد.

definition_en: to get excited, angry, or flustered
examples_en: Despite the boos from some in the audience, the actors on stage never lost their cool. | Although the group of skiers were in danger from an apparent avalanche, their ski guide never lost his cool.
definition_ar: أن يصبح الشخص غاضباً أو يفقد السيطرة على مشاعره.
examples_ar: حاول ألا تفقد أعصابك أثناء المفاوضات. | فقدت أعصابها عندما سكب النادل المشروب.

definition_en: to delay making a decision on (S)
examples_en: In making up the job announcement, the firm decided to leave the salary open until a qualified candidate was found. | We know that the annual summer camp will be held in August, but let's leave the exact dates open for now.
arabic: يترك مفتوحاً، يترك مجالاً لـ، يؤجل البت في
definition_ar: عدم إغلاق أو حسم أمر ما، مما يسمح باحتمالات مستقبلية.
examples_ar: سنترك المنصب شاغراً في الوقت الحالي. | سأترك الجدول الزمني مفتوحاً لزيارتك.

definition_en: to interest greatly, to excite (S)
note_en: The idiom with the opposite meaning is to turn off. These idioms are used to form the nouns turnon and turnoff.
examples_en: Does great art turn you on? | I find going to a museum and viewing classic works of art a real turnon. | Going to a bar and having silly conversation with strangers really turns me off. | In fact, most bar scenes are really turnoffs to me.
definition_ar: جعل آلة أو جهاز يبدأ في العمل عن طريق الضغط على مفتاح أو زر.
examples_ar: من فضلك أشعل الأضواء قبل أن يحل الظلام. | لا تنسَ تشغيل المدفأة.

definition_en: to lose an opportunity, to fail in some undertaking
examples_en: The precious metals market was looking up several months ago, but unfortunately most investors missed the boat. | Mr. | Vlasic's new business went bankrupt within a short time. | He really missed the boat by opening a tanning salon near the beach.
definition_ar: أن تكون متأخراً جداً للاستفادة من فرصة ما.
examples_ar: إذا لم تقدم طلبك الآن، فستفوتك الفرصة. | فوتُّ فرصة شراء تلك الأسهم الرخيصة.

definition_en: to invent, to create (also: to dream up)
note_en: This idiom is often used for an unusual or foolish thought.
examples_en: Who thought up the idea of painting the living room walls bright red? | When asked by the teacher why she was late, the student dreamed up a plausible excuse.
definition_ar: ابتكار أو خلق شيء ما، خاصة فكرة أو خطة.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك ابتكار عذر أفضل؟ | ابتكرت حلاً عبقرياً للمشكلة.

definition_en: to introduce an unexpected topic, causing embarrassment (S)
examples_en: The first week of class was going very well until a student threw the teacher a curve by suggesting that the textbook was too difficult. | The director asked us in advance to stick to the meeting agenda and not to throw him any curves.
arabic: يفاجئ بشيء صعب، يضع في موقف محرج، يغير الخطة فجأة
definition_ar: مفاجأة شخص ما بشيء صعب أو غير متوقع.
examples_ar: فاجأنا المدير بتغيير الموعد النهائي. | غالباً ما تفاجئك الحياة بمواقف صعبة عندما لا تتوقع ذلك.

definition_en: to create a disturbance, usually by complaining
note_en: This idiom is similar in meaning to the previous idiom, but the emphasis is on the aspect of complaining rather than causing embarrassment.
examples_en: In most companies, an employee who makes waves is not appreciated. | The meeting was going smoothly until one of the participants made waves about the newly revised compensation package.
arabic: يحدث ضجة، يثير المشاكل، يسبب اضطراباً
definition_ar: إحداث مشاكل أو جدل، غالباً عن طريق تغيير الوضع الراهن.
examples_ar: لم يرغب في إثارة المشاكل في وظيفته الجديدة. | بدأت أفكارها الراديكالية تحدث ضجة في المجتمع.

definition_en: to continue as before; to conduct, to engage in; to behave in an immature manner
examples_en: Even in the face of disaster, the inhabitants carried on as though nothing had happened. | The business associates decided to carry on their discussion in the hotel bar instead of the conference room. | I can't believe that John carried on so much just because his dog died. | He looked depressed and cried for weeks after it happened.
definition_ar: الاستمرار في فعل شيء ما أو التصرف بطريقة انفعالية أو متهورة.
examples_ar: من فضلك استمر في عملك بينما أنا بعيد. | استمروا في الحديث حتى وقت متأخر من الليل.

definition_en: absolutely not (also: no way)
note_en: This idiom is used as a kind of exclamation by itself.
examples_en: You're asking me to invest in that poorly rated company just because you know the son of the president? | Not on your life! | When a friend tried to get Mark to jump out of a plane with a parachute, he immediately responded, "No way!"
arabic: مستحيل، قطعاً لا، بأي حال من الأحوال
definition_ar: طريقة مؤكدة وقوية لقول أنك لن تفعل شيئاً ما تحت أي ظرف.
examples_ar: هل سأسامحه يوماً؟ مستحيل! | هل ستقفز من ذلك الارتفاع؟ مستحيل!

definition_en: to be extensive, to discuss much material
note_en: Forms such as a lot of, too much, too little are used before the noun ground.
examples_en: That national commission's report on urban ghettos covers a lot of ground. | Many of the recommendations are too costly to implement. | In his first lecture on Greek philosophers, I thought that our professor covered too little ground.
arabic: يقطع مسافة، يغطي موضوعاً، ينجز عملاً
definition_ar: قطع مسافة معينة أو تناول قدر محدد من المعلومات أو المواضيع.
examples_ar: لدينا الكثير من المواضيع لنغطيها في اجتماع اليوم. | تمكن الفريق من تغطية الكثير من الجوانب خلال مرحلة البحث.

definition_en: to be responsible for an office while others are gone
examples_en: It seems that all of our employees are taking a lunch break at the same time. | I wonder who's minding the store. | Lynne agreed to mind the store while the others went outside to watch the parade passing by.
arabic: يتولى المسؤولية، يدير العمل، يحرس المكان
definition_ar: تولي مسؤولية عمل أو مهمة أثناء غياب شخص آخر.
examples_ar: المدير في إجازة، لذا أنا أتولى إدارة العمل. | بينما يسافر الرئيس التنفيذي، يتولى نائب الرئيس إدارة العمل.

definition_en: to punish with full penalty, to be harsh on
examples_en: Because the criminal was a repeat offender, the judge threw the book at him with heavy fines and a long prison term. | My boss threw the book at me when he discovered that I had been using company time for personal business. | I was severely reprimanded and forced to make up the lost time.
definition_ar: معاقبة شخص ما بأقصى شدة ممكنة على ارتكاب مخالفة.
examples_ar: قرر القاضي تطبيق أقصى العقوبات على المخالف المتكرر. | إذا خالفت القواعد مجدداً، فسيعاقبونك بأقصى شدة.

definition_en: to say or do the wrong thing
note_en: This idiom is used with the noun phrase one's mouth or the pronoun it.
examples_en: Fred really put his foot in his mouth when he called his supervisor by the wrong name. | I really put my foot in it when I forgot my girlfriend's birthday and didn't buy her anything. | She almost lost her cool.
arabic: يقول شيئاً محرجاً، يخطئ في الكلام
definition_ar: قول شيء عن طريق الخطأ يسبب إحراجاً أو ضيقاً لشخص ما.
examples_ar: لقد أخطأت حقاً في كلامي عندما سألت عن زوجته السابقة. | لقد أفسد المفاجأة بذكر الحفلة في وقت مبكر جداً.

definition_en: to become available to others
note_en: This idiom is used when something is highly desirable to many other people.
examples_en: When one of the full-time contract instructors stepped down, her nice office overlooking the river was up for grabs. | Did you know that Senator Stone is retiring and that her Senate seat is up for grabs?
definition_ar: متاح لأي شخص ليأخذه أو يفوز به.
examples_ar: لقب البطولة متاح للمنافسة هذا العام. | هناك العديد من الوظائف المتاحة للتقديم.

definition_en: to display one's ability in order to attract attention (S); to let others see, to expose to public view (S)
note_en: This idiom can form the noun showoff for the first definition.
examples_en: Elizabeth is an excellent swimmer, but I don't like the way she shows off in front of everyone. | It's very obvious that she enjoys being a showoff. | Jacquie showed her large wedding ring off to all her friends.
definition_ar: التصرف بطريقة تهدف إلى جذب الانتباه إلى قدراتك أو ممتلكاتك.
examples_ar: إنه يتباهى بسيارته الجديدة فقط. | تحب أن تستعرض صوتها في الغناء.

definition_en: to become familiar with routine procedures at work or school
examples_en: The job applicant didn't have much previous experience or knowledge, but she seemed intelligent enough to learn the ropes quickly. | It took the new schoolteacher a year to learn the ropes regarding administrative and curricular matters.
arabic: يتعلم أصول المهنة، يتعرف على كيفية سير الأمور
definition_ar: تعلم كيفية القيام بعمل أو نشاط معين.
examples_ar: استغرق الأمر بضعة أسابيع لأتعلم أصول العمل في وظيفتي الجديدة. | ساعد المرشد المتدرب على تعلم أصول العمل.

definition_en: to hope to have good results, to hope that nothing bad will happen
note_en: This idiom reflects the way people cross their fingers to hope for good luck.
examples_en: Let's keep our fingers crossed that we got passing grades on that college entrance exam. | Jerry kept his fingers crossed that the good weather would hold up for the picnic he was planning for the coming weekend.
arabic: يتمنى الحظ السعيد، يأمل في نتيجة جيدة
definition_ar: الأمل في أن يحدث شيء ما بالطريقة التي تريدها.
examples_ar: أتمنى لك حظاً سعيداً في مقابلتك. | نأمل أن يبقى الطقس جميلاً.

definition_en: to recover safely from an unpleasant or dangerous situation
examples_en: After a series of personal and professional difficulties, it's amazing that George has landed on his feet so quickly. | Some young adults get into so much trouble at school that they are never able to land on their feet again. | They drop out before graduating.
arabic: يخرج من مأزق بسلام، يتجاوز الصعاب بنجاح
definition_ar: التعافي بنجاح من موقف صعب أو غير سار.
examples_ar: على الرغم من فقدان وظيفته، تمكن من تجاوز محنته والعثور على وظيفة أفضل. | لديها موهبة في الخروج من المآزق بسلام مهما حدث.

definition_en: to distribute in large quantity (S); to speak of others in a critical manner (S)
examples_en: Mary's mom dished out two or three scoops of ice cream for each child at the birthday party. | Larry can't seem to take any criticism of his actions but he certainly likes to dish it out.
definition_ar: توزيع شيء ما، غالبًا بكميات كبيرة أو بطريقة غير رسمية.
examples_ar: المدرب يوزع النصائح باستمرار على اللاعبين. | إنه يحب توزيع الإطراءات على كل من يقابله.

definition_en: to communicate with, to make someone understand (also: to break through to)
note_en: This idiom has the meaning of to make someone "catch on" (Lesson 29, eighth idiom, the first definition)
examples_en: Some of the students in my reading class understand English so poorly that it is difficult to get through to them. | The doctors have never succeeded in breaking through to Mr. | Ames, who is a silent and secretive patient.
arabic: يصل إلى فهم شخص، يتواصل بنجاح، يُقنع
definition_ar: النجاح في جعل شخص ما يفهم أو يصدق ما تقوله.
examples_ar: حاولت شرح المخاطر، لكنني لم أستطع إقناعه. | من الصعب أحيانًا الوصول إلى تفاهم مع المراهقين.

definition_en: to fulfill a promise, to be responsible
note_en: An idiom with the opposite meaning is to break one's word.
examples_en: Suzanne kept her word to me not to let on to others that I intend to step down next month. | Thomas always intends to keep his word, but invariably the end result is that he breaks his word. | He just isn't capable of being a responsible person.
definition_ar: القيام بما وعدت بالقيام به.
examples_ar: إنه رجل شريف يفي بوعده دائمًا. | لقد أعطيتك وعدي، وسأفي بكلمتي.

definition_en: to be very busy, to have too much to do (also: to be up to one's ears); to be beyond one's ability to understand
examples_en: I'd love to take a week off for a hiking trip, but at the moment I am over my head in work. | Maybe next week when I'm only up to my ears! | It was impossible for the tutor to get through to Bill about the physics problem because the subject matter was over Bill's head.
arabic: أكبر من قدرته، في موقف يفوق طاقته
definition_ar: أن تكون في موقف صعب أو معقد للغاية بحيث لا يمكنك التعامل معه.
examples_ar: تولى المشروع الجديد، لكنه كان بوضوح أكبر من قدرته. | أدركت أنها في موقف يفوق قدرتها عندما بدأت الديون تتراكم.

definition_en: to deserve, to receive a just punishment (also: to bring upon)
examples_en: If you drink alcohol and then drive a car, you're only asking for trouble. | Don't complain about your cut in salary. | You asked for it by refusing to heed our repeated warnings not to be late and inefficient.
definition_ar: طلب شيء ما أو استدعاء نتيجة معينة.
examples_ar: إنه يجلب المشاكل لنفسه بتجاهل قواعد السلامة. | طلبت كوبًا من الماء.

text: to be a far cry from
definition_en: to be very different from
examples_en: I enjoyed visiting Seattle, but it was a far cry from the ideal vacation spot I expected. | Ned is enjoying his new job, but his responsibilities are a far cry from what he was told they would be.
arabic: بعيد كل البعد عن، مختلف تمامًا عن
definition_ar: أن يكون الشيء مختلفًا تمامًا عن شيء آخر.
examples_ar: هذه الشقة الصغيرة بعيدة كل البعد عن القصر الذي كان يعيش فيه. | الفيلم الجديد مختلف تمامًا عن عمله السابق.

definition_en: certainly, definitely, naturally (also: of course); using any possible way or method
examples_en: If the Johnsons invite us for dinner, then by all means we have to return the invitation. | Of course, we don't have to invite their children, too. | In order to ensure its survival, the ailing company has to obtain an infusion of cash by all means.
definition_ar: تستخدم لإعطاء الإذن أو للتعبير عن الموافقة القوية.
examples_ar: بالتأكيد، تعال إلى الحفلة. | بالتأكيد، أخبرنا إذا كنت بحاجة إلى مساعدة.

definition_en: to restore one's financial security, to resolve a difficult financial obligation
examples_en: After years of struggling to get ahead, the young couple finally got out from under their debts. | The ailing company, succeeding in obtaining the necessary cash, was able to get out from under its financial burdens.
arabic: يتخلص من عبء، يتحرر من سيطرة
definition_ar: تحرير النفس من عبء أو دين أو سيطرة شخص ما.
examples_ar: استغرق الأمر سنوات ليتخلص من ديون دراسته. | تعمل في وظيفتين لتتخلص من مشاكلها المالية.

text: to take the bull by the horns
definition_en: to handle a difficult situation with determination
note_en: This idiom is usually used when someone has been postponing an action for some time and finally wants or needs to resolve it.
examples_en: After three years of faithful service, Jake decided to take the bull by the horns and ask his boss for a raise. | Vic has been engaged to Laura for a long time now, and I know that he loves her. | He should take the bull by the horns and ask her to marry him.
arabic: يواجه المشكلة بشجاعة، يمسك بزمام الأمور
ipa: /tu teɪk ðə bʊl baɪ ðə hɔːrnz/
definition_ar: التعامل مع موقف صعب بطريقة مباشرة وواثقة.
examples_ar: بدلاً من تجنب الصراع، قرر مواجهة المشكلة بشجاعة. | حان الوقت لمواجهة المشكلة بشجاعة وإصلاح هذا الفوضى.

definition_en: to assist, to aid, to help (also: to lend someone a hand) (S)
examples_en: Would you give me a hand lifting this heavy box? | When Terry's car broke down at night on the highway, no one would stop to lend her a hand.
definition_ar: مساعدة شخص ما في مهمة ما.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في حمل هذه الصناديق الثقيلة؟ | سأساعدك في واجبك المنزلي لاحقًا.

definition_en: to clap one's hands in applause, to applaud (S)
examples_en: After the talented new vocalist had sung her number, the audience gave her a big hand. | Should we give a big hand to each beauty contestant is as she is introduced, or should we wait until all the introductions are finished?
definition_ar: أن تصفق لشخص ما بحماس لإظهار التقدير أو الاستحسان.
examples_ar: دعونا نصفق بحرارة لضيفنا المتحدث. | صفق الجمهور بحرارة للمؤديين في نهاية العرض.

definition_en: to waste time, to be idle
examples_en: Some of the workers in our office always goof off when the boss is out. | On Saturday afternoons, I like to go to a movie or just goof off at home.
definition_ar: قضاء الوقت في كسل أو تجنب العمل والمسؤوليات.
examples_ar: توقف عن تضييع الوقت وأنهِ واجبك المنزلي. | طُرد من العمل لأنه استمر في التكاسل بدلاً من القيام بعمله.

definition_en: to answer in a rude manner, to speak disrespectfully
examples_en: Billy, if you talk back to me like that once more, you're going to spend the rest of the day in your room. | The school principal had to reprimand the child for talking back to her teacher.
definition_ar: أن ترد بوقاحة على شخص في موقع سلطة.
examples_ar: لا ترد بوقاحة على والدتك. | عوقب الطالب لأنه رد بوقاحة على مدير المدرسة.

definition_en: to be popular or fashionable; to be available at one's work or home
examples_en: Most young people tend to want anything that is in at the time, but a few don't care about current trends. | Could you please tell me when Mrs. | Zachary will be in? | I'd like to talk to her soon.
arabic: موجود في الداخل، مشارك في، موافق على
definition_ar: أن تكون متواجداً في المنزل أو العمل، أو أن تكون مشاركاً في نشاط ما.
examples_ar: هل المدير موجود اليوم؟ | أنا معكم في الرحلة إذا كنتم بحاجة لشخص آخر.

definition_en: to be unpopular or no longer in fashion; to be away from one's work or home
examples_en: These days, designer jeans are in and long skirts are out. | I'm sorry, Mr. | Jensen is out at the moment. | Could I take a message?
arabic: خارج المنزل، غير متاح، خارج المنافسة
definition_ar: أن تكون خارج المنزل أو العمل، أو أن تكون مستبعداً من شيء ما.
examples_ar: عذراً، هي خارج المكتب لتناول الغداء. | الأضواء مطفأة في المبنى بأكمله.

definition_en: to determine to be unacceptable, to refuse to consider
examples_en: I don't mind helping him with his homework, but I draw the line at writing a term paper for him. | The conference organizers tried to accommodate the needs of the various interest groups, but they drew the line at extending the conference by two days.
arabic: يضع حداً لـ، يرفض تجاوز حدود معينة
definition_ar: أن تضع حداً لما أنت مستعد للقيام به أو قبوله.
examples_ar: لا أمانع المساعدة، لكنني أضع حداً عند القيام بعملك بدلاً منك. | نحن مرنون، لكننا نضع حداً عند الأنشطة غير القانونية.

definition_en: to disobey or ignore normal procedures or rules (also: to step out of line)
examples_en: When a child gets out of line in that teacher's class, she uses the old-fashioned method of making the child sit in the corner of the room. | Any employee who steps out of line by coming to work in an unacceptable condition will be fired.
arabic: يتصرف بوقاحة، يخرج عن السيطرة، يخالف القواعد
definition_ar: أن تتصرف بطريقة غير مقبولة أو تخالف القواعد.
examples_ar: المعلم لن يتسامح مع الطلاب الذين يتصرفون بوقاحة. | إذا تجاوزت حدودك مرة أخرى، فسيتم إرسالك إلى المنزل.

definition_en: rehearsal, practice session
examples_en: The college president requested a dry run of the graduation ceremony in order to ensure that all aspects went smoothly. | Before the manager presented the reorganizational plans to the board of directors, he did several dry runs of his presentation.
definition_ar: بروفة أو جلسة تدريبية قبل الحدث الفعلي.
examples_ar: قمنا بتجربة عملية للعرض التقديمي للتأكد من أن كل شيء يعمل. | كانت تجربة الحريق مجرد تدريب أولي.

definition_en: to play music that one has heard but never read (S); to proceed without plan, to do spontaneously (S)
note_en: The pronoun it is often used with the second definition.
examples_en: That pianist can play most popular music by ear. | She never needs to read sheet music. | My husband wanted to plan our trip carefully, but I argued that it was more fun if we played it by ear.
arabic: يتصرف حسب الموقف، يرتجل، يتعامل مع الأمور بمرونة
definition_ar: أن تتعامل مع الموقف كما يتطور بدلاً من اتباع خطة مسبقة.
examples_ar: ليس لدينا جدول محدد، لذا سنتصرف حسب الموقف. | لست متأكداً كم سيستغرق الاجتماع، لذا دعنا نتصرف بمرونة.

definition_en: to be in another person's position, to face the same situation as another person
examples_en: If I were in your shoes, I wouldn't take too many classes this semester. | When his boss finds out about that accounting error, I wouldn't want to be in his shoes.
arabic: يضع نفسه مكان شخص آخر، يتعاطف مع وضع شخص
definition_ar: أن تتخيل نفسك في موقف أو وضع شخص آخر.
examples_ar: لا أريد أن أكون مكانك في هذا الموقف الآن. | لو كنت مكاني، لفهمت لماذا فعلت ذلك.

definition_en: to remind constantly, to nag
examples_en: Lynn always has to keep after her children about cleaning up their rooms and doing chores around the house. | Lon is so forgetful that it's necessary to keep after him about every little thing.
definition_ar: تذكير شخص ما أو حثه بشكل متكرر على القيام بشيء ما.
examples_ar: تُلحّ عليّ أمي لتنظيف غرفتي في كل عطلة نهاية أسبوع. | عليك أن تلاحقه وتُلحّ عليه إذا أردت إنجاز المشروع في الوقت المحدد.

definition_en: to repair or put back in good condition (S); to arrange a date or an engagement for another person (S)
examples_en: Instead of buying an expensive new home, we decided to buy an older home and fix it up ourselves. | Since my visiting friend didn't have a date for dinner, I fixed her up with a male friend of mine. | They got along very well together.
definition_ar: إصلاح أو ترميم أو تحسين حالة شيء ما.
examples_ar: قررنا ترميم المنزل القديم قبل الانتقال إليه. | قضى الصيف في إصلاح دراجته النارية.

definition_en: to be victimized or cheated
examples_en: When the jeweler confirmed that the diamonds that the woman had purchased abroad were really fake, she exclaimed, "I've been had!" The angry customer complained about being overcharged at the store, asserting that this was the third time that he had been had.
definition_ar: أن يتم خداع الشخص أو استغفاله من قبل شخص آخر.
examples_ar: دفعت ثمناً باهظاً لهذه الساعة؛ أعتقد أنني خُدعت. | أدرك أنه خُدع عندما تعطلت السيارة على الفور.
